escena: SCENE (Efeonce creative studio in Santiago, daytime, focused and energetic): behind her, softly out of focus, a large wall of screens shows a dense grid of dozens of near-identical generated image variations of the same abstract composition, cool and repetitive; in her hands an iPad Pro shows one single variation, the chosen one, glowing with a warm orange accent, and with the Apple Pencil she has just tapped it to mark the choice. She looks straight into the camera with a calm, confident, knowing half-smile; fresh and alert, natural-elevated make-up. She wears a light heather-grey fine knit t-shirt; no jacket, no navy or blue clothing. A current-generation smartwatch is on her left wrist, screen on. MEDIUM SHOT from the waist up, 85mm lens at f/2, focus on her eyes and the iPad. Her head, shoulders, hands and the iPad all sit inside the central horizontal band of the frame, between 25% and 75% of the frame height, with air above her head. The screens carry no letters, numbers or logos. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.
